clause: c_R2/f_RR can be zero by parent minimality, calculable by integrating out Xi, or retained as a fitted/phenomenological closure parameter.
implication: Only the first two are acceptable for derivable local GR; the third is modified-gravity phenomenology.

clause: R2/fR is absent at tree level if S_parent local exterior is explicitly EH+Lambda plus silent Xi and no R^2/f(R) term.
implication: Helpful but insufficient because loops/effective reduction/integrated-out sectors can regenerate terms.

clause: If Xi couples to curvature or trace/source variables, integrating it out can generate c_R2, Yukawa scalar exchange, or nonlocal kernels.
implication: This is the most honest likely origin if minimality fails.
required_fix: need Xi-curvature/source mixing matrix and mass/gap

clause: For a heavy scalar Xi with coupling beta_Xi Xi R and mass M_Xi, the effective local coefficient scales like beta_Xi^2/(2 M_Xi^2) up to normalization/sign conventions.
implication: This gives a route to c_R2 but not a value until beta_Xi and M_Xi are parent-derived.

clause: A symmetry could set beta_Xi=0 or forbid the scalar curvature channel.
implication: This is more credible than merely saying higher derivatives are ugly.
required_fix: identify symmetry/selection rule in MTS variables

clause: Setting c_R2=f_RR=0 by declaration is closure-only unless backed by MIN1967 or a symmetry theorem.
implication: Prevents accidental EH claim from a chosen minimal ansatz.
